verdict.rationale: Orb's first-party docs say its official SDK is available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, and Ruby, which directly delivers building against official SDKs across mainstream languages. A published OpenAPI 3.1 spec backs the API surface those SDKs target. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation (installation, usage examples, versioning or generation details) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Orb's SDK is available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, and Ruby.
